title: Gooey Toast
description: A toast that morphs from a pill into a blob to show its description and action, on top of Sonner, with promise states, a queue, swipe and Escape to dismiss.

props.name: preset / spring / bounce
props.description: GooeyToaster: the morph's feel. A preset sets spring and bounce; explicit values win.

props.name: visibleToasts / maxQueue / queueOverflow
props.description: GooeyToaster: how many toasts show at once, and what happens to the rest.

props.name: showProgress / showTimestamp
props.description: GooeyToaster: a countdown bar, and the time each toast appeared.

props.name: gooeyToast(title, options)
props.type: options: { description?, action?: { label, onClick, successLabel? }, icon?, timing?: { displayDuration? }, fillColor?, borderColor?, classNames?, onDismiss?, onAutoClose? }
props.description: Show a toast. Also gooeyToast.success, .error, .warning, .info, .promise, .update and .dismiss.

a11y: A persistent pair of live regions announces every toast: polite for default, success and info, assertive for warning and error, and each toast also carries role=status or role=alert.
The action is a native button; Escape dismisses the most recent toast; swipe to dismiss is touch only and can be turned off.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the morph jumps straight to its end shape, the icon swap and content fades take 10 ms, and the stack transition is reduced to opacity.
The status icon is decorative (aria-hidden, a Labs addition); the title carries the meaning, and each type also has its own color and icon.
usage: gooeyToast.success("Changes saved", { description: "Your profile is up to date." })

loop.script: click[0] → wait → wait → click[2] → wait → wait
